name: Bakuetsu! Chimou Yuugi "Kakutou Shimai Monmon Hen"
original_name: 爆悦！恥妄遊戯「格闘姉妹悶々編」
source:
Main character's plans to live by holding a dojo fail. He goes to his sister's dojo to challenge her and collapses there. After being fed, he challenges sister, and with some side support the fight ends in a draw. Then the sides to settle the dispute by running dojo again. And to reduce protagonist's chances of winning girls prepare special training sessions for him each day.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-april-2001-mizuiro.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公原本想靠经营道场维生，计划却以失败告终。他前往姐姐的道场向她挑战，却在那里倒下。吃过东西后，他再次挑战姐姐，并在旁人的暗中相助下与她战成平手。于是，双方决定通过重新经营道场来解决争端。为了降低主人公获胜的机会，女孩们每天都为他准备了特别训练。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-april-2001-mizuiro.html]vndbreview[/url]]
